Controls the sample rate of the output audio. The default is `48000` Hz. Match this to your source audio to avoid resampling artifacts.

## CLI flag

Use `--sample-rate` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--sample-rate <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--sample-rate <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--sample-rate <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--sample-rate <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--sample-rate <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#samplerate)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#samplerate)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#samplerate)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#samplerate)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setSampleRate(44100);
```
